output.explanation:
The central tree retains the seed's four main responsibilities while shrinking from 95 to 62 lines (34.7%) and from 6,728 to 4,675 characters (30.5%). Five peripheral trees expand validation/model conversion, source capture and cache ownership, request retries, durable publication, and diagram identity. Modular structure organizes the central tree; peripherals mix call sequences, resource ownership and data dependencies. Edges attach to the corresponding concept lines. Positions use measured text dimensions with gaps and no overlaps.

Evidence is limited to context.json and seed.json. The value peripheral follows agentContext.ts; pins follows agentContextSource.ts and fileAgentContextSources.ts; reuse follows agentContextLibrary.ts, savedAgentContext.ts and fileAgentContextRepository.ts; disk follows fileAgentContextRepository.ts; binding follows diagramAgentContext.ts.

Source-grounded corrections: the seed's exact-byte Git comparison actually compares hashes of line arrays after CRLF/LF splitting. Identical comment retries compare the existing comment's text/hash and return before checking the current snapshot hash; only new comments require the current hash. Trajectory cycle/missing-entry checks cover the selected parent walk, while duplicate IDs are checked across all entries. Sections permit multiple sibling blocks with one nesting level. The version mapping describes generated snapshots; imports can accept higher versions without their triggering features. Diagram storage validates a 64-hex backing ID but does not establish how the supplied store derives it. Loading checks provenance/session identity and declared content hash, without recomputing the source fingerprint against a current diagram.

Added details include cache eviction and failure recovery, sequential capture, request checks before recapture, lock/resource cleanup, and discovery tie-breaking. The source adapter's actual limit is 16 MiB despite stale 2 MiB comments/error text. Imported adapters, ImmutableRecords internals, and downstream editing/evaluation callers were not supplied, so their implementation guarantees are not inferred. The shared editing/evaluation boundary comes from the supplied point definition; call sequences shown are static readings of the supplied code.

AgentContext -- validation and model conversion
|-- Value boundary
|   |-- Private snapshot cloned on construction and toSnapshot()
|   `-- withMessages preserves source/range; recomputes version and hash
|-- Trajectory validation scope
|   |-- Duplicate entry IDs checked across all supplied entries
|   `-- Parent traversal stops at fromEntryId; other branches are not walked
|-- Import compatibility
|   |-- Ranges require version >= 2; sections require version 3

Source adapter -- capture, cache and transport
|-- Source contract
|   |-- Paths reject absolute forms, backslashes, NUL, empty or dot segments
|   `-- file hash = SHA-256(JSON({startLine, lines})); path is excluded
|-- capture chooses evidence
|   |-- Revision: resolve commit; ls-tree accepts only 100644/100755 blob
|   `-- No revision: corpus text -> split CRLF/LF into lines
|       |-- HEAD comparison hashes normalized line arrays, not raw bytes
|       `-- Different content or failed HEAD lookup -> snapshot blob
|-- FileAgentContextSources owns resources
|   |-- ImmutableRecords under agent-context-sources stores snapshot files
|   |-- Git promise cache key: binding.root + commit + path
|   |-- Maximum 16 entries; evict oldest insertion; hits do not refresh order
|   `-- Failed cached reads removed so later requests can retry
|-- Limits and availability
|   |-- File byte bound and Git maxBuffer use the 16 MiB constant
|   |-- NUL-containing source rejected; registry required for Git reads
|   `-- Snapshot loads use blobs; supplied attachments can support offline use
`-- portable remaps each distinct reference
    |-- Extract selected lines; preserve original startLine
    |-- Slice hash changes when line offset changes
    `-- Rewrite inside sections too; attach slices; rehash descriptor

Library -- request receipts and metadata
|-- create receives repository plus optional source adapter
|   |-- Constituent arrays hash name/description/raw blocks/optional group
|   |   `-- Check prior request before capture: retry does not repin files
|   |-- Text/snapshot requests hash name/description/context hash/optional group
|   |   `-- Build/validate context before looking for an existing receipt
|   `-- Capture blocks sequentially; sourceFile requires source adapter
|-- fork retry ordering
|   |-- Hash ['fork', parsed input]; look up destination request ID first
|   |-- Matching receipt returns existing fork before rereading parent
|   `-- New fork checks parent hash; group:null clears inherited group
|-- addComment executes under repository metadata lock
|   |-- Existing request ID: compare text and recorded hash; return or conflict
|   `-- New request ID: compare current snapshot hash, then append timestamp
|-- Metadata ownership
|   |-- Group changes do not rewrite requestHash or snapshot
|   `-- Comment records describe a content hash; fork does not copy comments
`-- Discovery reads saved records
    |-- Equal createdAt values sort by agentContextId ascending
    |-- Limit defaults to 20, maximum 100; end returns nextOffset:null
    `-- Lineage reports parentMatches; mismatch alone does not fail

File repository -- publication and lock lifetime
|-- create(record)
|   |-- Open unique temporary file with wx and mode 0600
|   |-- Write JSON -> fsync file -> close handle
|   |-- Hard-link to final ID; EEXIST leaves prior record in place
|   |-- Fsync directory -> read/validate final record -> compare requestHash
|   `-- finally removes temporary file
|-- mutateMetadata(id, callback)
|   |-- mkdir <record>.lock coordinates writers across processes
|   |-- EEXIST: wait 10 ms; fail busy after 5-second deadline
|   |-- Read record -> mutate -> validate saved-record schema
|   |-- Write/sync/close unique temporary file -> rename over record
|   |-- Fsync directory
|   `-- finally removes temporary file and lock directory
|-- read(id)
|   |-- Validate ID, JSON schema, record identity and context hash/history
|   `-- Missing file returns null; other failures propagate
`-- summaries()
    |-- Missing directory returns empty list
    `-- Reads and validates each matching saved-record JSON before summarizing

Diagram binding -- evidence dependencies and checks
|-- compileDiagramAgentContext(diagram)
|   |-- Fingerprint = SHA-256(JSON({binding or null, evidence}))
|   |-- Each originalLines slice -> file hash -> attached sourceRange
|   |-- sourceId fallback: evidence entry -> binding -> diagramId

|-- Separate identities
|   |-- sourceSessionId=diagramId; agentType=diagram-context
|   |-- compiledFromRevisionId records capture revision
|   `-- contentHash covers conversation; sourceFingerprint covers source input
|-- storeDiagramAgentContext
|   |-- Existing stored reference returned after validation
|   `-- Inline snapshot -> store.put -> require 64 lowercase hex characters
`-- loadDiagramAgentContext
    |-- Inline snapshot or store.get(backingRecordId) -> AgentContext validation
    |-- Compare declared contentHash when present; check provenance and session
